svg.title: FOX Studio. Protect.
svg.desc: Animated opening on a black background. One word at a time in the centre, in hard cuts that get faster, each over its own abstract painting in greys, moving slightly (a brushed disc, a brushed orbit, concentric orbits, an ink wash, a spatter of stars, a hatched sphere, a horizon, a celestial chart): the verb to protect in eight languages that share one root. PROTEGER (Portuguese, in orange), PROTECT (English), PROTÉGER (French), PROTEGGERE (Italian), PROTEGIR (Catalan), PROTEJA (Romanian), PROTEKTI (Esperanto) and, last and a little longer, PROTEGERE (Latin, the root of them all). Then, in one more hard cut, only the FOX Studio fox-in-hexagon logo and the name FOX Studio remain.
